en.name: Flounder
en.summary: Flounder is a flatfish that lies on the seabed with both eyes on its upper side, and the name covers a good many species. What they share is what matters here: four thin fillets per fish, tapering almost to nothing at the tail, lean and delicate. From purchase it keeps 1–2 days in the fridge and 6–8 months in the freezer.
en.pantry: No room-temperature life at all. A thin fillet has an enormous amount of surface for its weight and nothing in the way of fat to slow anything down, so it warms through in minutes and goes slack within an hour or two of a hot kitchen. Cool bag on the way home, and the 2-hour rule, cut to 1 hour above 32 °C (90 °F). Do not leave the fillets out while the oven comes up to temperature — put them back in the fridge and fetch them when the pan is hot.
en.fridge: 1–2 days from purchase at 4 °C (40 °F) or below. Keep the fillets flat and dry on a rack, chilled from beneath by ice, with the melt water draining somewhere other than onto the fish; thin flatfish flesh absorbs water faster than almost anything else on the counter and turns to paste if it is left sitting in it. If you are not cooking today, buy the fish whole instead — the skin and the frame protect the flesh, and a whole flounder lets you check the eyes and gills yourself rather than trusting a label. Bottom shelf, under everything ready to eat.
en.freezer: 6–8 months at −18 °C (0 °F), a longer window than most white fish get, because there is so little fat here to go rancid. The risk is entirely drying. Lay the fillets flat with baking paper between them so you can lift out one at a time, wrap so that no air touches the surface, or dip them in cold water and let an ice glaze set. Being thin cuts both ways: they freeze through quickly, which protects the texture, but the tapered tail end burns first if the wrapping is loose. Safe indefinitely at −18 °C; the months are quality.
en.thawing: A few hours in the fridge on a plate is all thin fillets need, and they can also go into a hot pan straight from frozen, which suits them — either way a flounder fillet is a two-minute job. Never thaw them on the counter and never refreeze them raw.
spoilage: A sour or ammoniacal smell rather than a clean, faintly sweet one.
Flesh that stays dented when pressed instead of springing back.
A milky or sticky film on the fillet, or liquid pooling under it.
Grey or yellowing edges, and flesh that tears when you lift it.
tips: Buy whole if you are not cooking it today; fillets go over faster.
Keep the fillets on a rack, never sitting in melt water.
Freeze thin fillets flat with paper between them, so you can take one at a time.
Cook flounder straight from frozen if you forgot to thaw it — thin fillets cope well.

faq.q: How long does flounder keep in the fridge?
faq.a: 1–2 days from purchase at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, on ice and not sitting in water.
Yes, 6–8 months at −18 °C. Freeze the fillets flat and airtight, or ice-glazed.

faq.q: Can you cook flounder from frozen?
faq.a: Yes. Thin fillets cook well from frozen in a hot pan or oven, and it avoids the mushiness that slow thawing can cause.

faq.q: How can you tell if flounder has gone off?
faq.a: A sour or ammoniacal smell, a milky film on the surface, or flesh that will not spring back when pressed.

zh.name: 比目魚
zh.summary: 比目魚是貼著海床生活的扁身魚，兩隻眼睛都長在上側，而這個名字底下其實涵蓋不少種類。牠們共同的地方正好和保存有關：一條魚取下四片薄魚片，到尾端幾乎薄到沒有，低脂又細緻。從購買日起冷藏可放 1～2 天，冷凍 6～8 個月。
zh.pantry: 完全沒有室溫可言。薄魚片相對於重量有龐大的表面積，又沒有脂肪可以拖慢任何事，所以它幾分鐘就回到室溫，在熱廚房裡一兩個小時就癱軟。回家路上用保冷袋，並遵守 2 小時原則，氣溫超過 32 °C 時縮到 1 小時。不要一邊等烤箱預熱、一邊把魚片擺在檯面上——先冰回去，等鍋熱了再拿出來。
zh.fridge: 從購買日起放 4 °C 以下 1～2 天。魚片要平放在網架上、保持乾爽，底下用冰降溫，並讓融水流到魚碰不到的地方；薄的扁魚肉吸水的速度大概是整個魚攤上數一數二快的，泡著就變成一攤糊。如果今天不煮，改買整條：魚皮和骨架替魚肉擋住外界，而且整條可以自己看眼睛和鰓，不必只信標籤。放最下層，位置低於所有即食食品。
zh.freezer: 在 −18 °C 下 6～8 個月，比多數白肉魚的期限長，原因是它幾乎沒有會產生油耗味的脂肪。這裡的風險完全是變乾。魚片壓平、中間夾烘焙紙，之後才能一次拿一片；包到表面碰不到空氣，或浸冷水讓表面結一層冰衣。薄有兩面：它凍透得快，對口感有利，但只要包裝鬆了，尾端那個最薄的位置一定先凍燒。在 −18 °C 下安全性可以無限期維持，月數講的是品質。
zh.thawing: 薄魚片放盤子上冷藏幾小時就夠了；也可以直接從冷凍下熱鍋，這樣反而適合它——不管哪一種，一片比目魚都是兩三分鐘的事。絕對不要放檯面解凍，生魚也不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 聞起來發酸或有氨味，而不是乾淨的淡甜味。
按壓後凹陷回不來，而不是有彈性。
魚片表面出現乳白黏膜，或下方積水。
邊緣泛灰泛黃，拿起來就散。
tips: 今天不煮就買整條；魚片壞得比較快。
架在網架上，不要泡在融水裡。
薄魚片壓平、中間夾紙冷凍，之後一次取一片。
忘了解凍就直接從冷凍下鍋——薄魚片完全可以。

faq.q: 比目魚冷藏可以放多久？
faq.a: 鋪冰、不泡水，放 4 °C 以下，從購買日起 1～2 天。
可以，−18 °C 下 6～8 個月。魚片壓平密封，或做冰鍍。

faq.q: 比目魚可以直接從冷凍下鍋嗎？
faq.a: 可以。薄魚片直接下熱鍋或進烤箱表現很好，還能避免慢慢解凍造成的軟爛。

faq.q: 怎麼判斷比目魚不新鮮了？
faq.a: 發酸或氨味、表面出現乳白黏膜，或按壓後沒有彈性。
